# BAD-045 — Split web/booth.js (1406 lines) into booth-<part>.js classic scripts

## Brief
Plan: [[docs/spikes/bad-036/web-booth|web-booth spike]] (Marfona, BADS-036).

Proposed: five contiguous classic scripts at web/ top level: booth.js 530 (the recording room, kept as the entry), booth-screening.js 293, booth-cam.js 129, booth-render.js 211, booth-export.js 243, summing to 1406. The two files over 250 are argued with their optional cuts. Test edits: web-guest-mode.test.js at line 447 and fonts.test.js at line 144 must cover every booth-*.js file.

Cross-ticket: shares the tag-derived test helper and the duplicate-name sweep with the web/app.js and web/collabweb.js splits.

Verification: the concatenation check, npm test, npm run web and web:build. Hold-to-record, Save to Photos, the share sheet and the live render service are invisible to a browser run; the simulator, web:live and web:local cover them per section 10.

**Gate.** Queued until Eric approves the proposed file layout in the spike. Phase 2 does not start before that approval, and an approval that changes the layout is written into the spike's section 4 first.

**Rules for Phase 2, from BAD-036.** Split by responsibility; 250 lines is where a file gets a second look, not a cap, and every file left over 250 is argued in the spike's section 6. Every PR is a pure move: no statement is edited, a bug found on the way is its own ticket, and the spike's behaviour-preservation check (section 8) runs on every PR. The public surface in section 2 is the compatibility contract and does not change. Extraction order follows section 9: shared constants, types and pure utilities first, then state and services, then sub-components or handlers, then the entry file reduced to an orchestrator. Verification is the implementing-changes skill's tier for the files touched, quoted in each PR.

## Size, persona and model decision
Eric's call, 2026-09-15: the spike's layout is approved as proposed (section 4 unchanged: booth.js 530 kept as the recording room, booth-screening.js 293, booth-cam.js 129, booth-render.js 211, booth-export.js 243; neither optional cut in section 6), and Phase 2 lands as ONE pull request for the whole split, with the section 8 concatenation and unit checks as its proof. One engineer on opus in a worktree on feat/bad-045-split-web-booth after bash scripts/worktree-init.sh, then a reviewer on opus (Fable's weekly limit is reached, Eric 2026-09-15) who reruns the checks before the PR. No member, child or probe runs on fable. web/booth.js is byte-unchanged between the spike's revision 20d11e1 and origin/main 5751929, so the spike's line numbers hold; BAD-044 already made test/web-guest-mode.test.js read view-script groups from index.html's tags, which this split reuses.
